cases.prompt: Prepare neutral questions for tomorrow's discovery call with Acme.
cases.standalone_behavior: Complete the call plan without another pack.

cases.prompt: Find 50 manufacturing companies that fit our ICP and verify public business contacts.
cases.standalone_behavior: State that list building is outside this pack; do not misroute to sales-qualification.

cases.prompt: Write a four-touch cold email sequence for prospects who have never spoken with us.
cases.standalone_behavior: State that cold outbound copy is outside this pack; do not misroute to objection handling.

cases.prompt: The buyer thinks migration is risky. Help me understand and answer the concern without changing terms.
cases.standalone_behavior: Analyze and draft a truthful response from available evidence.

cases.prompt: They want 12% off for annual prepayment. Compare authorized trades for this deal.
cases.standalone_behavior: Build an authority map and conditional options without committing.

cases.prompt: Redesign our pricing tiers, packaging, and company-wide discount policy.
cases.standalone_behavior: State that portfolio pricing strategy is outside this pack; do not treat it as one negotiation.

cases.prompt: Based on these call notes, should the named Acme opportunity advance or return to discovery?
cases.standalone_behavior: Return a reversible status, evidence, and next validation.

cases.prompt: Design lead scoring, routing, lifecycle stages, and auto-advance rules in our CRM.
cases.standalone_behavior: State that RevOps system design is outside this pack; do not change or simulate CRM records.

cases.prompt: Review why the named Acme deal was lost from the supplied timeline and records.
cases.standalone_behavior: Complete an evidence timeline and causal review without external research.

cases.prompt: Research Competitor X's current site, reviews, pricing, and SEO footprint.
cases.standalone_behavior: State that external competitor research is outside this pack; do not fetch under deal review.

cases.prompt: First help me understand why the buyer says the competitor is safer, then compare a conditional scope-for-price trade.
cases.standalone_behavior: Handle both outcomes sequentially, bounding the secondary section to three bullets if only one skill is available.

cases.prompt: Assess qualification first, then give me the three discovery questions most likely to change that status.
cases.standalone_behavior: Answer qualification and then provide at most three discovery questions when the adjacent skill is unavailable.

cases.prompt: Turn our recurring objections into a reusable battlecard and team training deck.
cases.standalone_behavior: State that reusable collateral is outside this pack; offer only a bounded evidence outline.

cases.prompt: Draft a follow-up email from this discovery debrief and flag every unverified claim.
cases.standalone_behavior: Draft a deal-specific follow-up, label it as not sent, and retain unknowns.

cases.prompt: Review the lost deal, draft the CRM post-mortem, and draft a team announcement.
cases.standalone_behavior: Review first and label each of the two discrete action-shaped drafts separately; do not modify or publish anything.
